column1: # The server and the docs this engine's committed answers come from.
# default records the tapes: Oracle Database 23ai Free, release 23.26.3
# (product_component_version.version_full). parser judges
# oracle/parser/testdata/compat.tsv at the same 23.26.3 release so a judge
# revision bump rejudges compat.tsv without touching the default-pinned tapes.
# parser judge revision 4 runs the judge with MAX_STRING_SIZE=EXTENDED, adds
# TYPE (y/w) and DIMENSION (d/e) fixture objects, adds offset-preserving
# stand-ins (ALTER TYPE, ALTER DIMENSION, INMEMORY JOIN GROUP, CREATE PLUGGABLE
# DATABASE USING/SOURCE_FILE_DIRECTORY, SHARING, CREATE PFILE, NO DELETE UNTIL,
# UNTIL TIME, AUDIT POLICY, missing schema a.), adds end-of-statement checks
# (65018, 65168), and classifies parser syntax codes (3059, 38107, 46601, 46603).
# parser judge revision 5 switches compat.tsv to coarse accept/reject verdicts
# (exact ParseError.Position byte offsets are pinned in TestErrorPositions in
# oracle/parser/parse_errors_test.go), expands JudgeFixture (t PRIMARY KEY, t2,
# composite-partitioned p, nested table type nt_t) and grants CREATE LIBRARY /
# CREATE MLE, adds rev-5 stand-ins (PL/SQL/LIBRARY scratch schema, CREATE SCHEMA
# scratch schema, LOCK TABLE p, MV/MV-log/UPGRADE nested-table and split
# stand-ins, AUDIT -> NOAUDIT, SHARD/SCALE sequence, GLOBALLY -> EXTERNALLY,
# PDB SNAPSHOT, DIMENSION self-loop, USING INDEX/FLASHBACK ARCHIVE, SPFILE,
# TABLESPACE SET, managed standby recovery, REF missing type), classifies
# underlying ORA-22324/02425/02426 stack diagnostics and structural PL/SQL
# errors, and guards early-error exits against unclosed '('.
# simulate judges oracle/catalog/testdata/simulate.tsv (TestSimulation) on the
# default-pinned server, so a judge revision bump re-records that suite alone.
# simulate judge revision 1 reads a period's check constraint, which Oracle
# names <period> and six random hex digits, as <period>$PERIOD.
# docs is the syntax OracleDocs.g4 is converted from: the statement pages of the
# SQL Language Reference oracle/parser/bnf/ quotes, the SHA-256 of what
# oracle/parser/cmd/docsgrammar reads of them, and the date they were quoted.
# columns: role, image, digest, source tag, judge revision
